subject: Onboarding: invoice channel options and staged net-cycle proposal

Cc: SupportOps Procurement <procure@orchard.co>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 21:22:00 -0700
Subject: Orchard onboarding — preferred invoice lane and billing cadence

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the quick intro last week — excited to get Orchard set up in Redwood's vendor portal. To speed things along our finance team asked two questions I wanted to confirm before we submit the onboarding packet:

1) What invoice delivery channel do you prefer for new vendors? We can do email to ap@redwood.com, portal upload to your vendor portal, or EDI if that's required.
2) On payment terms: your onboarding form lists Net 45 as standard for first engagements, but our treasury prefers Net 30. We're open to a staged cadence (e.g., 50% upon acceptance of first invoice, remainder Net 45) or an early-pay option in exchange for a small discount. Any flexibility here?

I've attached our completed onboarding form and W-9 so you have the paperwork ready.

Attachments: orchard_onboarding_form.pdf (form, 2 pages), orchard_w9.pdf (W-9)

Thanks — looking forward to your guidance so we can get PO flow established.

Best,
Ari Kaplan
Head of Finance Ops
Orchard Analytics
ari@orchard.co
(415) 555-0126

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>

Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orchard onboarding — preferred invoice lane and billing cadence

Hi Ari — great to hear from you and thanks for the attachments. Looping in David from Finance and Ben from Procurement Ops so we can align quickly.

Short answers up front:
- Preferred channel: vendor portal upload (ap-portal@redwood.com) is easiest for us for PO matching; email to ap@redwood.com is acceptable for the first month while we confirm portal access. EDI is not required for onboarding.
- Terms flexibility: we can support Net 30 for the first two invoices if Orchard needs that, but we typically keep Net 45 as baseline. If Orchard prefers earlier settlement, we can offer an early-pay program (1% discount for payment within 10 days on Net 30) or a staged invoicing approach (30% deposit on first invoice, remainder Net 45).

Action items:
1) Ari — confirm you want portal upload as default and whether you want the Net 30 pilot for two invoices or the staged deposit structure.
2) Ben — please initiate PO template with invoice delivery lane set to vendor portal and include a PO note for "Net-cycle pilot: Net30 for first 2 invoices" if Ari confirms.
3) David — if early-pay discount is viable for Orchard, can you confirm the discount tier we can offer (percent / approval needed)?

Thanks all — happy to hop on a 20-minute call if that makes it faster.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Manager, Vendor Onboarding
Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com

Hi all — quick Finance input. We reviewed Orchard's request and risk profile. Proposed options we can approve without exec sign-off:

Option A (Net30 pilot): Net 30 for first two invoices. No discount. If Orchard requests faster settlement we can enable an early-pay discount through our AP early-pay program. Typical tiers are 1.0% for payment within 10 days (on Net30 invoices) or 0.5% for payment within 15 days (on Net45 invoices).

Option B (Staged deposit): 30% deposit on initial invoice, remainder Net 45. This helps with cashflow but increases PO/AR complexity on our side. Finance will accept it for a single onboarding engagement if Procurement logs it on the PO.

Ben — please confirm portal PO note and set invoice delivery to ap-portal@redwood.com. Ari — if you choose Option A and want early-pay discount enabled, let me know which tier (10-day / 15-day).

Thanks,
David Kim
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
david.kim@redwood.com
